Overview of Haryana Digital Initiatives

The official portal of the Government of Haryana (haryana.gov.in) continues to serve as a central repository for state-level administrative resources, cultural heritage information, and digital governance tools. The portal acts as the primary access point for various citizen services and departmental updates.

Key Digital and Administrative Updates

  • Accessible India Campaign (Sugamya Bharat Abhiyan): The Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD) has implemented this nationwide campaign to improve digital inclusion. According to the state portal, Haryana has successfully made the websites of all 22 districts accessible, alongside the websites of 73 state departments.
  • Budgetary Contributions: The platform hosts a section for citizens to submit suggestions regarding the Haryana State Annual Budget, reflecting an effort to engage in public consultation.
  • Emergency and Relief Services: The portal documents various historical administrative responses to the COVID-19 pandemic, including the TRACKPDS platform, relief camp management systems, and registration services for stranded individuals during the lockdown period.

Verification and Access

Citizens seeking the most current information regarding government schemes, department notifications, or accessibility compliance can access the official portal at https://haryana.gov.in/.

Users are encouraged to verify specific departmental updates directly through the government’s official domain, as the portal serves as a gateway to individual ministry websites. The state provides a dedicated helpline for COVID-19 related queries at 8558893911 or 1075 (excluding the districts of Gurugram and Faridabad).
